synthesis.popular_take: Inferred media narrative: Morozov is rising rapidly with a dominant right hand and increasing mass, while Ermes remains a proven counter to top-level power with elite back pressure and toproll defense. The public expects a close, strategical battle hinging on wrist control, height battles, and who can impose their preferred range first.
synthesis.counter_case: Ermes could leverage his upgraded back pressure and evolving press to blunt Morozov's frame-based pressure if he can force Morozov into uncomfortable wrist postures.
synthesis.what_community_might_be_missing: Concrete, independent measurements of Morozov's current wrist health and Ermes's wrist mechanical data; official match footage beyond fan-cut clips; objective timing of Morozov's peak for this bout.
synthesis.key_question: Will Morozov's recent form translate into dominant right-hand pressure, or can Ermes continue to neutralize power with top-roll progression and back pressure? How will wrist posture and height dynamics decide the pace of the match?

ermes_case.summary: Ermes's current weight around 127-128 kg; implies mass and leverage for right-hand readiness.

Ermes anticipates a difficult Morozov left-arm match, indicating foreseen challenge.
Opening the opponent's finger in top-roll demonstrates Ermes's go-to entry for wrist control.
Belief in top-roll over hook against Levan signals a strategic baseline for Morozov's upcoming scenario.
Ermes' recent 130kg+ weight and victory on the right hand signs peak form against top-level opposition.

morozov_case.summary: Morozov's right arm improving daily; recovery progress.
IVs and intensive prep indicate high-level investment in conditioning.
Post-surgery strength rising on right hand; defensive/offensive capability improving.
Increased reserve strength now; higher ceiling for performance.
Official weight at around 140 kg; larger frame translates to power potential.
Belief that Morozov will peak for the match; timing matters.

uncertainty_flags: Reliance on non-official video commentary for current-form signals.
Injury statuses (Ermes left arm, Morozov wrist) may shift closer to event day.
Some claims derive from promotional or speculative content rather than formal competitive results.
Source bias from prominent armwrestling media personas could color interpretation.
Differences between left-hand vs right-hand performance in reported claims add ambiguity.
